description: This is a shell script used for modifying Android system image files, specifically targeting build.prop files within a target files zip package to update security patch levels and vendor version information, and then repackages the system image accordingly.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: exit_badparam
methods.description: Prints an error message, shows usage, and exits the script.

methods.name: cleanup_and_exit
methods.description: Cleans temporary files and exits, called on script termination.
